title: A day on Ba Be Lake
duration: One full day between two nights
summary: Wake in a stilt house at Pac Ngoi, take the morning boat across the open water and through Puong, and come back to the house. Add Dau Dang only on the long circuit.

days.title: The lake morning
days.body: Breakfast is the house meal. The middle of the day is the boat across the open water and through Puong. Dau Dang belongs on that boat only when the circuit is the long one. How long the boat runs is Check on arrival. The evening returns to the floor.

stops.name: Pac Ngoi
stops.note: Wake in a stilt house and start the day from the village.

approach.note: The morning circuit leaves the village by boat.

stops.name: Ba Be Lake
stops.note: Take the open water from the village.

approach.note: The same boat continues through the cave.

stops.name: Puong Cave
stops.note: Ride through the cave on the morning boat.

additions.name: Dau Dang Waterfall
additions.note: Add the waterfall when the boat is the long circuit.

seoTitle: A day on Ba Be Lake
seoDescription: One lake day from Pac Ngoi: the morning boat across the open water and through Puong. Dau Dang is the long circuit. The boat length is Check on arrival.
